source.exactLocator: L39-L49; L41 describes the rule conditionally for voids within a feature class or subtype; L49 states line errors are created from outlines of void areas or between noncoincident polygon boundaries.
source.supportedFact: When Must Not Have Gaps identifies a void, Esri records line errors along void outlines. The candidate expresses this conditionally and makes no claim about the specific exercise geometry or feature-class membership.

targetBinding.oldValue: Если ошибки проверять топологией Esri, контур пустоты будет линейной ошибкой Must Not Have Gaps, а область перекрытия — полигонной ошибкой Must Not Overlap.
targetBinding.newValue: В топологии Esri, если Must Not Have Gaps выявляет пустую область, ошибка отмечается по её контуру как линейная.
